content_sections.heading: Assam Rifles Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Assam Rifles opened online applications for Technical and Tradesman posts on 28 September 2026. Eligible candidates must complete the application process by 28 October 2026 at 11:59 PM. The recruitment rally is tentatively scheduled from 23 November 2026 onwards.

content_sections.heading: Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesman Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesman Recruitment 2026 notification lists 354 tentative vacancies across 18 trades. Warrant Officer (Cipher) has the highest number of vacancies with 124 posts, followed by Rifleman (Electrical Fitter Signal) with 32 posts.

content_sections.heading: Assam Rifles Recruitment 2026 Category-wise Vacancy
content_sections.text: The recruitment notification provides separate category-wise vacancy allocations for Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, Other Backward Classes, Economically Weaker Section and Unreserved candidates. There is no state-wise quota.

content_sections.heading: Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesman Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the educational qualification and age requirements prescribed for their chosen Assam Rifles trade. The notification includes opportunities for candidates with Class 10, Class 12, relevant ITI qualifications, technical diplomas and specified healthcare qualifications. Applicants for Warrant Officer (Cipher) must have passed 10+2 with English and Mathematics from a recognized board, along with the prescribed technical qualification. The notification specifies recognized computer or information technology-related diploma qualifications. The technical trades include Electrical Fitter Signal, Lineman Field, Armourer, Engineer Equipment Mechanic, Recovery Vehicle Mechanic, Electrician Motor Vehicle, Instrument Mechanic, Metalsmith, Upholster, Store Keeper Technical, Vehicle Mechanic, Welder and Mason. Educational requirements vary by trade and generally include Matriculation with relevant ITI certification, technical training or a recognized diploma in the prescribed discipline. Important: Trade-wise educational qualifications, course durations, ITI specializations and age limits are separately prescribed in Appendix A of the official notification. Candidates must verify the exact requirements for their selected trade before applying.

content_sections.heading: Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesman Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesman Recruitment Rally 2026 application fee is Rs. 100 for candidates required to pay the fee. SC, ST and Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempted. Candidates may pay through the online payment facility or the prescribed SBI Bank Challan option. Payment receipts must be retained for verification during the recruitment rally.

content_sections.heading: Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesman Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The Assam Rifles recruitment process consists of several stages to assess physical fitness, technical knowledge, trade skills and medical eligibility. Initial document verification. Physical Efficiency Test (PET). Physical Standard Test (PST). Computer Based Test (CBT). Trade Skill Test. Document Verification. Detailed Medical Examination (DME). Review Medical Examination (RME), where applicable. Candidates qualifying the preliminary physical and document checks will be considered for further stages. The Trade Skill Test is qualifying in nature. Shortlisting is based on CBT merit and the applicable recruitment conditions.

content_sections.heading: Assam Rifles Physical Efficiency Test 2026
content_sections.text: The Physical Efficiency Test requires candidates to complete the prescribed running distance within the qualifying time.

content_sections.heading: Assam Rifles Physical Standard Test 2026
content_sections.text: The Physical Standard Test includes height, chest and weight measurements. Relaxed standards apply to eligible candidates from specific regions and tribal categories. Weight must be proportionate to height and age according to the prescribed medical standards. Candidates claiming a physical standard relaxation must produce the required supporting certificate.

content_sections.heading: Assam Rifles CBT Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesman Computer Based Test will consist of 100 multiple-choice questions carrying 100 marks. The examination duration is two hours, and negative marking will apply. The question paper will be based on the Food Safety Officer syllabus prescribed by the recruiting department.

content_sections.heading: Assam Rifles Trade Skill Test 2026
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates must undergo the Trade Skill Test relevant to their applied post. The test consists of practical assessment of the required technical or vocational skills. The Trade Skill Test is qualifying in nature. Candidates must pass this stage to remain eligible for further recruitment formalities.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesman Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can submit the Assam Rifles Technical and Tradesman Recruitment Rally 2026 application online through the official Assam Rifles website by 28 October 2026 at 11:59 PM. Visit the official Assam Rifles website at https://www.assamrifles.gov.in/ . Open the Technical and Tradesman Recruitment Rally 2026 notification. Read the complete eligibility requirements for the relevant post or trade. Select the Online Application option. Complete the application with personal, educational, contact and domicile details. Select the appropriate trade and reservation category. Complete the prescribed fee payment if applicable. Review the application carefully before submission. Submit the application and download the acknowledgement. Print the completed application form and retain the fee receipt or challan. Carry the application printout and required original documents when reporting for the recruitment rally. Important: Candidates may submit only one online application. Requests to change the trade, category or submitted information after final submission will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Assam Rifles Recruitment 2026 Important Documents
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess the required eligibility and identity documents when completing their application and attending the recruitment rally. Class 10 certificate for date of birth verification. Relevant educational qualification certificates and mark sheets. ITI, diploma or technical training certificates, where applicable. Domicile / Permanent Residential Certificate. SC, ST, OBC or EWS certificate, where applicable. Ex-Servicemen documents, where applicable. Online application form printout. Application fee payment receipt or SBI challan, where applicable.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts has Assam Rifles advertised in this Rally?
faq.answer: 354 Group C posts across 18 technical trades, all-India, with no state-wise quota.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: 28 October 2026, till 23:59 hrs; the online portal opens on 28 September 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Can women apply for this Rally?
faq.answer: No. All 18 advertised trades are open to male candidates only.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Most trades require 18–23 years; Cipher, Draughtsman, Operation Theatre Technician and Physiotherapist require 18–25 years, as on the cut-off date of 1 July 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: RFID-based Physical Standard Test (PST) and Physical Efficiency Test (PET), Documentation Verification, a Computer Based Test (CBT), a Trade Skill Test, and a Detailed/Review Medical Examination, followed by a trade- and category-wise Merit List.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: Rs. 100/- for Group C posts; no fee for SC/ST and Ex-Servicemen candidates. The fee is non-refundable.

faq.question: Q7. Is there a quota for Ex-Servicemen?
faq.answer: Yes, 10% of vacancies are earmarked for Ex-Servicemen in most of the advertised trades; unfilled ESM vacancies go to non-ESM candidates of the same category.

faq.question: Q8. Where do I apply?
faq.answer: Online only, through assamrifles.gov.in; only one application per candidate is accepted.
